'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Syrian civil war]]
**[[2024 Syrian opposition offensives]]
***[[Battle of Aleppo (2024)|Battle of Aleppo]]
****[[2024 Aleppo University Hospital airstrike]]
*****Twelve people are killed and 23 others are injured in [[Russia]]n airstrikes on a hospital in [[Aleppo]], [[Syria]]. [https://www.syriahr.com/en/350325/ (Syrian Observatory for Human Rights)]
****[[Turkey|Turkish]]-backed militants say that they captured Aleppo's [[Ramouseh]] district as well as the city of [[As-Safira]] and the town of [[Khanasir]] in [[Aleppo Governorate]]. [https://www.aljazeeramubasher.net/news/2024/12/1/%D9%85%D8%B9%D8%A7%D8%B1%D9%83-%D8%AD%D9%84%D8%A8-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%85%D8%B9%D8%A7%D8%B1%D8%B6%D8%A9-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B3%D9%88%D8%B1%D9%8A%D8%A9-%D8%AA%D9%86%D8%AA%D8%B2%D8%B9 (Al Jazeera Mubasher)] [https://www.syriahr.com/%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%87%D9%8A%D8%A6%D8%A9-%D9%88%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AC%D9%8A%D8%B4-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%88%D8%B7%D9%86%D9%8A-%D9%8A%D8%B3%D9%8A%D8%B7%D8%B1%D8%A7%D9%86-%D8%B9%D9%84%D9%89-%D8%A8%D9%84%D8%AF/738575/ (Syrian Observatory for Human Rights)]
***At least nine people are killed and at least 62 others are injured in Russian airstrikes on [[Idlib]]. [https://www.syriahr.com/en/350332/ (Syrian Observatory for Human Rights)]
***The [[Syrian National Army]] says that they captured the city of [[Tell Rifaat]] and [[Menagh Air Base]] in Aleppo Governorate. [https://www.aljazeeramubasher.net/news/politics/2024/12/1/%D9%82%D9%88%D8%A7%D8%AA-%D8%B9%D9%85%D9%84%D9%8A%D8%A9-%D9%81%D8%AC%D8%B1-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AD%D8%B1%D9%8A%D8%A9-%D8%AA%D8%B9%D9%84%D9%86-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B3%D9%8A%D8%B7%D8%B1%D8%A9 (Al Jazeera Mubasher)] 
*[[Sudanese civil war (2023–present)|Sudanese civil war]]
**[[Battle of Khartoum (2023–2025)|Battle of Khartoum]]
***The [[Rapid Support Forces]] establish a civilian administration in the [[Sudan|Sudanese]] capital of [[Khartoum]], including the adjacent cities of [[Omdurman]] and [[Khartoum North]]. [https://www.thenationalnews.com/news/mena/2024/11/30/sudans-rsf-sets-up-civilian-administration-in-khartoum/ (''The National'')] [https://www.dabangasudan.org/en/all-news/article/sudan-war-rsf-set-up-civilian-administration-in-khartoum-state (Radio Dabanga)]
*[[Colombian conflict]]
**Clashes between [[FARC dissidents|FARC dissident]] groups Raúl Reyes Front and [[:es:Comandos de la Frontera|Frontera Commands]] leave twelve militants dead in [[Puerto Guzmán]], [[Putumayo Department]], [[Colombia]]. [https://www.dw.com/es/combates-entre-disidentes-de-farc-dejan-12-muertos-en-colombia/a-70942586 (Deutsche Welle)]
*[[Insurgency in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa]], [[Sectarian violence in Pakistan]]
**The number of people killed during [[sectarian violence]] in [[Khyber Pakhtunkhwa]], [[Pakistan]], during the last ten days has increased to 130. [https://apnews.com/article/pakistan-sectarian-clashes-kurram-death-toll-25716632b51657063cc4203739de7f72 (Associated Press)]
*[[Mali war]]
**A [[Malian Armed Forces|Malian army]] [[drone strike]] in [[Tinzaouaten]] kills eight leaders of the [[Strategic Framework for the Defense of the People of Azawad]] coalition. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/mali-army-drone-strike-kills-several-tuareg-rebels-ministry-says-2024-12-01/ (Reuters)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2024 North Indian Ocean cyclone season]]
**Nineteen people are killed by [[Cyclone Fengal]] in [[India]] and [[Sri Lanka]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/cyclone-fengal-kills-19-india-sri-lanka-2024-12-01/ (Reuters)]

'''International relations'''

**[[National Security Advisor (United States)|U.S. National Security Advisor]] [[Jake Sullivan]] says that the [[United States]] will not return the [[Ukraine and weapons of mass destruction|nuclear weapons]] that they dismantled to [[Ukraine]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/us-will-not-return-nuclear-weapons-ukraine-2024-12-01/ (Reuters)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2024 Nzérékoré stampede]]
**At least 56 people are killed during a [[Human stampede|stampede]] at a football match in [[Nzérékoré]], [[Guinea]], after the police [[tear gas]]sed the [[Football pitch|field]] as rival fans stormed it following a controversial [[referee]] decision. A police station is later [[Arson|set ablaze]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/amp/news/2024/12/2/dozens-feared-dead-after-stampede-breaks-out-at-guinea-football-match (Al Jazeera English)]
*[[Weiss special counsel investigation]], [[Federal pardons in the United States]]
**[[United States]] [[President of the United States|President]] [[Joe Biden]] [[presidential pardon|pardons]] his son [[Hunter Biden]] of tax and firearms charges. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cjwl3venz39o.amp (BBC News)]
*Seventy-nine people are injured in [[football hooliganism]] clashes between fans of [[FC Carl Zeiss Jena]] and [[BSG Chemie Leipzig (1997)|BSG Chemie Leipzig]] following a match in [[Jena]], [[Thuringia]], [[Germany]]. [https://www.dw.com/en/german-football-violence-leaves-79-injured/a-70931907 (Deutsche Welle)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2024 Icelandic parliamentary election]]
**In [[Iceland]], the [[Social Democratic Alliance]] wins 15 seats in the [[Althing]] elections, with the incumbent [[Independence Party (Iceland)|Independence Party]] winning 14 seats. However, no party achieved a majority. [https://www.dw.com/en/iceland-opposition-social-democrats-win-election/a-70931905 (Deutsche Welle)]
*[[2024 Liechtenstein referendums#1 December|2024 Liechtenstein referendums]]
**Citizens of [[Liechtenstein]] vote in a [[referendum]] to form a state [[pension fund]]. The vote passes with a 52.6% majority. [https://www.vaterland.li/liechtenstein/politik/spl-referendum-es-duerften-genug-unterschriften-sein-art-579157 (''Liechtensteiner Vaterland'')]
*[[2024 Romanian parliamentary election]]
**[[Romanians]] vote for the 330 seats of the [[Chamber of Deputies (Romania)|Chamber of Deputies]] and the 136 seats of the [[Senate of Romania|Senate]]. [https://www.rferl.org/a/romanians-vote-parliament-presidential-election-disputes-georgescu/33221766.html (Radio Free Europe/Radio Liberty)]
